name: DOM-based cross-site scripting
mental_model: Browser-side code moves attacker-influenced data from a source into an executable DOM sink without a safe transformation.
security_property: Untrusted client-side data must not reach an executable browser sink unless transformed for that exact sink.
root_causes: Missing source-to-sink validation or context-aware encoding
signals: A URL, storage, or messaging source reaches a DOM write
The sink interprets HTML or code
The server response does not contain the marker

hypothesis_templates.statement: Data controlled through {source} may flow through {client_path} into {sink} without a safe transformation, causing {controlled_effect}.
preconditions: The client application is explicitly in scope
The source and sink can be exercised with an inert marker
hypothesis_templates.expected_safe_behaviour: The client uses a text-only sink or applies the exact required transformation.
hypothesis_templates.expected_vulnerable_behaviour: Untrusted data reaches an executable sink and produces the controlled effect.
hypothesis_templates.falsifier: The path terminates before the sink or the sink keeps the marker inert.
stop_conditions: The effect would read browser secrets
The data flow crosses an unapproved origin

safe_test_pattern: Trace one inert local marker from a controlled client-side source to the exact sink and compare executable and text-only local controls.
positive_controls: Trusted data updates the intended DOM element
negative_controls: The same untrusted marker reaches a text-only sink and remains inert
falsifiers: A sanitizer or safe sink is effective in the exercised context

minimum_evidence.description: Recorded source-to-sink trace and controlled client-side outcome.
Why the source is untrusted and the sink is expected to remain non-executable.
Equivalent text-only sink negative control and trusted-update positive control.
Clean client-state repeat proving the same source-to-sink path.
Human statement limited to the demonstrated same-origin controlled effect.

common_false_positives: String presence without an executable sink
A source controlled only by trusted application state
A sanitizer effective for the exact sink
impact_boundaries: A dangerous API call alone is not a vulnerability
A local effect does not prove access to tokens or another user's data
minimum_impact_rules: Do not access storage, cookies, or external origins
Keep the proof inside the controlled local fixture
remediation: Validate and transform data for the exact sink

revisions.summary: Initial client-side source-to-sink card and browser-free fixture.
